purpose: Reviewer-owned new contract, not candidate code or student work; fixture prepared before reading a new candidate.
task: At the inspection snapshot, predict ok/check for a new sample from reading, a 2x2 occupancy grid, and unordered zone.

roles.sample_id: opaque output identifier, excluded from features
roles.reading: numeric measurement; 0 is observed, null/CSV blank/NaN means missing
roles.grid: grid[row][column], exactly 2x2 integers 0/1; aggregate first COLUMN by summing over rows
roles.zone: unordered category; train-known blue/red; unseen values use all-zero indicator vector
roles.target: ok/check known; ? means unknown, not negative

training_rule: This reduced teaching contract fits both numeric imputation and supervised classifier on known-target training rows only. Unknown row is retained in raw table but excluded from both fits. This is not the full official Antique semi-supervised requirement.
validation_rule: No fitting on validation inputs or truth. No final test data or score is supplied. Report this small validation only.

reference_models.centroid: Euclidean nearest class centroid. Class tie order ok then check only for this reference. No baseline query has a centroid tie.
reference_models.alternative: 3NN, k=3, squared Euclidean, equal distance ordered by provided training row order; majority vote. It is intentionally accepted despite a different V9 prediction.

scope_limits: No claim of representing all Robot inputs or solving its official task.
No new candidate notebook has been read or executed.
A correct alternative model need not reproduce the centroid predictions.
Reviewer reference results are not student achievement.
